program.name: Bell Surprise
program.subject: Surprise
program.blurb: One kettlebell and a different subject every day, all twenty before any repeats.
program.about: Twenty subjects with one kettlebell, one a day. Bell legs, presses, pulls, hips, grip, core, complexes and conditioning share the deck with boxing, HIIT, jumps, Pilates, yoga, mobility and back care, and each comes once before any comes back. Each time it is a different format, with a short finisher or bell lift after. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Every day a different subject · one kettlebell, 35 minutes
